data.desc: Prestige Consumer Healthcare Inc. (NYSE: PBH) is a leading consumer healthcare company growing trusted, category-defining brands. Headquartered in New York, the Company markets, sells, manufactures, and distributes its products across the U.S., Canada, Australia, and select other international markets. Its diverse portfolio of iconic brands includes Breathe Right, Monistat, Summer's Eve, BC, Goody's, Dramamine, Fleet, Hydralyte, Gaviscon, DenTek, TheraTears, Clear Eyes, Compound W, Dermal Therapy, Chloraseptic, Luden's, Little Remedies, Boudreaux's Butt Paste, Nix, and Debrox, among others. Learn more at www.prestigeconsumerhealthcare.com.
